I told Pree in your DM that the cutoff date for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. That's what Pree told me on 14 October.

I got the date from our DM history, not from GBrain. When I asked GBrain for what's saved about Pree, it returned nothing, not even the private note I saved last time. The likely reason is that this connection can only read back notes marked visible to everyone. If so, private notes can be saved here but never read back. For now, a member's own DM history is the reliable place to look up what they asked me to remember.
